start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-pages-cited-by-answer-engines for https://bakery.example.com/pricing against https://chat.example.com/?q= with facts older than 90 days refreshed, using my word rules."
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it writes one page-citations record to the person's own records and compares it with the earlier one.
instructions: 1. Give pages (your own pages and the questions each answers), answer_engines (the address of each engine with a question slot), freshness_days and rules; message is optional.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-pages-cited-by-answer-engines". It forms one cell for every page, question and engine, asks each engine and measures which cells cite your page.
3. It reads each page, marks facts older than freshness_days as stale, finds the current value in a primary source and rewrites only changed or undated sections, then checks them against your rules.
4. It saves a draft, previews and publishes only through tools it actually has, reads the live page back and records the date, citations and changes; a missing tool is reported as a gap.

worked_examples.title: Two questions on one page make two cells
worked_examples.ask: Check whether the engine cites my pricing page.

questions: How much does bakery order software cost?
Is there a free plan for bakery order software?
